plan.notes: BA in Biology. Official Monmouth College 'Academic Plan' (sample plan). One Monmouth course credit = 4 credit-hours; credits modeled in Monmouth course credits exactly as printed. The plan places major courses and first-year Core Foundations; remaining credits each term are filled with Core Requirements or general electives per the plan's instructions (those fillers are not modeled). Italics in the source indicate prerequisites exist - see the catalog for chains; not modeled here. 'Or' rows occupying one slot are modeled as single choice slots. Flexible 'take in either term' rows are modeled in the first-listed term and documented. Pages undated (retrieved 2026-10-09); catalog_year labeled 2026-2027. Degree requires 31 course credits. Year 1 Fall totals 5 credits as printed; the page notes FYQR 120 may be met by a QR waiver, in which case CHEM 140 moves to the spring. BIOL 350 Science Seminar is printed in both junior terms (0.25 each; Requirements page: '2 semesters') - transcribed as printed (allow_repeated_courses documented here). BIOL 440 and 450 must be taken in sequential semesters per the Requirements page.
